logp.method_description: The lipophilicity of complexes 1–5 was determined by using the “shake-flask” method previously reported [31]. The concentrations of the Fe(II) complexes in each phase were determined by UV–Vis analysis. LogP was calculated as the logarithmic ratio of the concentrations of the Fe(II) complex in the n-octanol phases and aqueous phases.
